findings.one_line: The supplied source-of-record text establishes only C^1 regularity of the map curve; it does not state the claimed uniquely normalized linearized Monge--Ampere derivative or the hypotheses under which that conclusion holds.

cited_checks.note: The attested verbatim excerpt says only that {nabla phi_t} is C^1 in C^{1,alpha}; it does not supply the asserted derivative equation, normalization, or its precise hypotheses.

The attested Proposition 29 statement matches the claimed uniform-to-uniform T^2, fixed-point, periodized-KDE limit with normalization sqrt(n/log(1/h_n)) and covariance I_2/(4 pi), and does not cover the proposed variable-coefficient generated-target setting.

The attested Theorem 3.3(iv) gives |nabla_x G(x,y)| <= K |x-y|^{1-n} under the theorem's elliptic regularity and domain hypotheses; in n=2 this is the stated inverse-distance bound, and interior localization supplies the use away from the boundary.
The attested theorem states exactly the fixed-source torus C^{2+beta} mixed C^{1+beta} times C^beta linearization remainder used by this cited node.
